name: Small cichlid omnivores
description: Small omnivorous cichlids picking invertebrates, periphyton and detritus from the bottom. Functional group pooling five source compartments - Mesonauta festivus, Acaronia nassa, Satanoperca acuticeps, Acarichthys heckelii and Geophagus spp. (G. proximus, G. surinamensis) - aggregated because the source treated these small benthic omnivorous cichlids as one guild.
